description: DO NOT GENERATE A REPLACEMENT zo_mcp_server.py. zo_mcp_server.py is in PROTECTED_FILES; we are NOT rebuilding it. INSTEAD generate a Markdown patch instructions file at /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/zo_mcp_server_auth_patch.md that documents EXACTLY what 2-line change activates bearer auth and how to roll it out without breaking the three current callers (claude.ai web connector, claude.ai mobile connector, future tower Invoke-Check.ps1). Document: (1) PRECONDITION: stub 001_auth_probe_2026-04-29 has fired and verdict=='pass' (proving FastMCP middleware is the only auth gate). If verdict=='fail' or 'inconclusive', this directive must NOT be applied — there is invisible orchestration we don't understand and flipping the local switch will not gate it correctly. (2) THE 2-LINE PATCH in zo_mcp_server.py: replace `_MCP_SECRET = ""` (literally line ~38) with `_MCP_SECRET = os.environ.get("ZO_MCP_SECRET", "")` and remove the `# os.environ[...] = ...` comment line directly above it. The middleware logic underneath does not change; it already enforces correctly when _MCP_SECRET is non-empty. (3) ROLL-OUT SEQUENCE: (a) Generate or pick a long random secret. (b) Set ZO_MCP_SECRET in the launch environment for zo_mcp_server (find the launcher script via `grep -r zo_mcp_server /etc/zo/ /home/workspace/`); add `export ZO_MCP_SECRET='<value>'` before the python3 zo_mcp_server.py line; restart the server. (c) BEFORE switching connectors over, drop a fresh stub 004_auth_probe_with_token from the tower with the same secret in $env:ZO_MCP_SECRET on tower, verify all three sub-probes — (no header), (wrong bearer), (correct bearer) — produce the expected 401/401/200 pattern. If any deviation, ROLL BACK by unsetting the env var and restarting the server. (d) Once tower-side probe passes, update claude.ai connector (Settings → Integrations → ZoComputer MCP) to send Authorization: Bearer <secret>. Log out and back in to refresh credentials. Test from web. (e) If web works, update mobile connector with the same secret. Test from mobile. (f) If both work, update Invoke-Check.ps1's environment by setting ZO_MCP_SECRET as a Windows machine-level env var on tower (so NSSM ZoWarmWorker inherits it). (g) Any one of (d)/(e)/(f) failing = roll back the server-side env var; auth comes back off and we investigate why that caller couldn't carry the bearer. (4) ROLLBACK PROCEDURE: SSH or terminal into the ZO container, unset ZO_MCP_SECRET, restart zo_mcp_server. Endpoint immediately reverts to open. (5) DOCUMENT in BRIDGES.md update: bridge 1 now requires bearer auth; the secret lives in three places and rotating it is a four-step process. NO CODE EXECUTED BY THIS DIRECTIVE — the output is purely the Markdown runbook for a human to execute when stub 001 has passed. Include a checklist at the bottom that a human can tick through in order.
